title: A tailor's orders
checked: Every reachable state checked (4 states, 67 with their data, 105 steps). All 5 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 4 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
One order at the measuring, one at the cutting table, two at the sewing machines, one in the fitting room.
The shop is all ready only when every order hangs on the rail.
rules.path: Take away the all ready guard and it breaks in 1 step: move an order.

rules.says: The shop says held up only when no order can move on.
rules.path: Take away the nothing can move guard and it breaks in 1 step: move an order.

rules.rule: A customer comes only to a fitting
rules.says: Nobody is called in unless an order waits in the fitting room.
rules.path: Take away the an order is at the fitting guard and it breaks in 2 steps: move an order, the customer comes in.
